common.loadError: Couldn’t load this. Check your connection.

photo.why: A clear photo of your face helps farms recognise you on day one.

location.denied: Location permission was not given. Type your postcode instead.
location.noPostcode: Couldn’t find a postcode for your location. Type it instead.
location.failed: Couldn’t get your location. Type your postcode instead.

form.fixFields: Please fix the highlighted fields above.

admin.title: Admin account
admin.body: Admin tasks (approving farms, handling reports, suspending users) are done in the Supabase dashboard for now. The mobile app is for workers and farms.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account has been suspended by the Croppr team. If you think this is a mistake, contact us at {{email}}.

chat.farmEmpty: No conversations yet. Message an applicant from your shortlist, or accept them to start a chat.
chat.title: Chat
chat.hiddenFarm: Phone numbers, emails, links and social handles are hidden (#####) until you accept {{name}}.
chat.hiddenWorker: Phone numbers, emails, links and social handles are hidden (#####) until the farm accepts you.
chat.reported: Thanks. The Croppr team will review your report.

farm.title: Register your business
farm.intro: Every farm on Croppr is checked by our team, so workers can trust the jobs they see.

worker.title: Set up your profile
worker.intro: Farms use this to pick their crew. It takes about 3 minutes.

welcome.headline: Get matched with farm work across Australia.
welcome.sub: Whether you’re after a season’s work or hiring your next crew.
welcome.already: Already have an account? Pick either option and sign in with your email.

signIn.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We’ll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.

verify.enterCode: Enter the {{length}}-digit code from your email.
verify.badCode: That code didn’t work. Check it, or request a new one.
verify.title: Check your email

chooseRole.title: How will you use Croppr?
chooseRole.intro: You can’t change this later, so pick the one that fits.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Croppr holds information like your visa details and payslips, so here’s how we look after it and the rules everyone on Croppr agrees to.
consent.draft: These are draft documents for testing and will be finalised before launch.
consent.agreeTerms: I agree to the Terms of use

verification.verified: {{name}} is verified. Workers see the Verified badge on your jobs.
verification.resubmit: Update your details in the Farm tab to resubmit.
verification.checking: We’re checking your ABN. This usually takes one business day. You can post jobs once you’re verified.
verification.checkingLabourHire: We’re checking your ABN and labour hire licence. This usually takes one business day. You can post jobs once you’re verified.

account.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your profile, visa details, photos and messages. It can’t be undone.

farmProfile.legalNote: Changing your business name, ABN or labour hire details means we re-check them before you can post new jobs.

jobs.copied: Copied from your earlier job. Set the new dates and check the pay.

jobCard.farmEstimate: Farm’s estimate: may count as specified work
jobCard.estimateOnly: Estimate only, based on the postcode and type of work. Check with Home Affairs before relying on it.

match.availablePct: Available for {{pct}}% of the job dates
match.noCarRequired: No car, but one is required
match.noCar: No car; needs another way to get there

resume.tooBig: That file is over 5 MB. Try a PDF or a smaller photo.
resume.title: Resume
resume.note: Optional. Import your resume (PDF, Word or a photo). Only farms you apply to can open it.

report.title: Report {{subject}}
report.intro: Reports go to the Croppr team, not to the other person. If you’re in danger, call 000.

dispute.title: Dispute the no-show
dispute.body: Tell the Croppr team what happened at {{farm}}, for example who you worked with or any messages. Until they decide, this no-show doesn’t count against you.

outcome.waitingFarm: Thanks. We’ll confirm it once the farm answers.
outcome.waitingWorker: Thanks. We’ll confirm it once {{name}} answers.
outcome.completed: Confirmed by both of you: it’s now a verified work record.
outcome.disputed: Your answers were different. The Croppr team will look into it; nothing counts until then.
outcome.title: Did this work out?

saved.emptyBody: Swipe a job up, or tap the bookmark, to keep it here while you decide.

broadcast.title: Message your crew
broadcast.label: Crew message
broadcast.placeholder: e.g. Start 6am Monday at the main shed. Bring a hat and water.
broadcast.private: Each worker gets this in their own chat with you, so replies stay private.

logShift.title: Log a shift
logShift.alreadyLogged: You already logged {{hours}}h at {{employer}} on {{date}}. Replace it with {{newHours}}h?

alerts.title: Job alerts
alerts.note: One summary a day (about 6pm) of new jobs that match. Uses the dates you’re available on your profile.
alerts.instant: Tell me straight away about great matches
alerts.instantNote: Jobs that really suit you (pay, distance, dates) come through as soon as they’re posted. Everything else waits for the daily summary.

filters.title: Filter jobs
filters.minPayHint: For piece-rate jobs this uses the guaranteed hourly minimum.

employer.badAbn: That ABN doesn’t look right (it’s optional)
employer.name: Employer name
employer.postcodeHint: Where the work was done (eligibility depends on the postcode).
employer.notEligible: Not an eligible postcode for {{visa}} plant & animal cultivation. Only count it if it’s another kind of specified work.
employer.countsNote: e.g. plant and animal cultivation in an eligible regional postcode. Turn off for other jobs (like a city café) so they aren’t counted.

group.title: Travelling with friends?
group.together: Farms see your group together on their shortlist so they can hire you all at once. Each person still swipes and applies for themselves.
group.shareMessage: Join my group on Croppr with code {{code}}
group.intro: Link up so farms know you want to work together. One person creates a group and shares the code.

worker.messagesNote: When a farm sends you a message.
worker.updatesNote: Accepted or not, no-shows, and “did this work out?” when a job ends.

farm.messagesNote: When a worker sends you a message.
farm.updatesNote: New applicants, and “did your crew work out?” when a job ends.
farm.remindersNote: On a job’s first day, to check in your crew.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.note: Choose which notifications you get on this phone.

payslip.title: Add payslip
payslip.intro: Copy the details from your payslip and attach a photo or PDF. Only you can see it.

employerDetail.payslipsEvidence: Payslips are the best evidence for your visa application.
employerDetail.confirmBody: This deletes its {{shifts}} shifts and {{payslips}} payslips.

matches.messagesEmpty: No messages yet. When a farm messages you or accepts your application, the chat appears here.
matches.emptyBody: Swipe right on jobs in Discover to apply. Farms review applicants and reply in Messages.
matches.verified: ✓ Verified by you and the farm
matches.outcomeDisputed: You and the farm answered differently. The Croppr team is looking into it.
matches.waitingFarm: Thanks for answering. Waiting for the farm to confirm.
matches.leftEarly: The farm marked you as leaving early.
matches.disputeUpheld: The Croppr team reviewed your dispute and the no-show stands.
matches.disputePending: You disputed this. The Croppr team is looking into it.
matches.disputeSent: Dispute sent. The Croppr team will look into it.

discover.savedForLater: Saved for later. Find it in Matches → Saved.
discover.widen: Try widening your filters to see more jobs.
discover.checkBack: Check back soon: farms post new jobs every day.

days.notWhm: Your profile says you’re not on a 417/462 visa, so you probably don’t need specified work days.
days.reached: Target reached 🎉 Check with Home Affairs before you apply.
days.suggestion: You were accepted at <bold>{{farm}}</bold> ({{job}}). Track your days there?
days.noEmployers: Add the farm you’re working at, then log your shifts or upload payslips.
days.verified: ✓ Verified by you and the farm
days.rules: Counting rules v{{version}}: full-time weeks ({{weekHours}}+ hrs over {{weekDays}}+ days) count 7 days; otherwise shifts of {{dayHours}}+ hrs count as a day; each calendar day counts once.

farmJobs.emptyBody: Post a job and Croppr will build you a ranked shortlist of available workers.

shortlist.allFilled: All spots filled: mark job as filled
shortlist.filledHidden: Marked as filled. It no longer shows to workers.
shortlist.closedHidden: Job closed. It no longer shows to workers.
shortlist.checkInPrompt: Who turned up? Check in your crew
shortlist.rankingFailed: Couldn’t refresh match scores. Showing the last ranking.
shortlist.rankedBy: Ranked by match score: availability, distance, car, experience and reliability.
shortlist.title: Applicants
shortlist.acceptBody: That makes {{filled}} of {{needed}} filled. They’ll see "Accepted" in Croppr and you can message them.
shortlist.declineBody: They’ll see “Not this time” in Croppr.

attendance.title: Who turned up?
attendance.explain: Workers you mark as turning up can be rated, and their job counts as completed when it ends. A no-show tells the worker, who can dispute it with the Croppr team.
attendance.empty: No accepted workers on this job.
attendance.disputed: Disputed: the Croppr team will decide

applicantDetail.visaPrivate: Croppr only shows whether the visa covers your job dates; visa details stay private.

farmPage.gone: This farm isn’t on Croppr any more.

rating.blind: Ratings are blind: they can’t see yours until they’ve rated you too, or 14 days have passed. You can’t change it later.
rating.didntStay: I didn’t stay in their accommodation
rating.farmNote: Shown to other workers with your first name. {{blind}}
rating.workerNote: Only farms this worker applies to can see it. {{blind}}

reviews.reportBody: Tell us what’s wrong, for example it’s untrue, abusive or shares private details. The person who wrote it isn’t told who reported it.

farmForm.businessNote: We check your ABN (and labour hire licence, if you have one) before you can post jobs.
farmForm.name: Business or trading name
farmForm.labourHire: We are a labour hire provider
farmForm.labourHireNote: Supplying workers to other growers. Queensland requires a labour hire licence.
farmForm.licenceHint: We check this against the Queensland labour hire licence register.
farmForm.phoneHint: Only Croppr staff see this. Workers contact you through in-app chat.
farmForm.aboutHint: What you grow, seasons, what workers can expect.

farmPageEditor.title: Your farm page
farmPageEditor.intro: Workers see this when they tap your farm name. Photos of the work, the crew and any accommodation help people decide.
farmPageEditor.accommodationPlaceholder: Type, cost per week, what’s included, or nearby options

profileForm.visaNote: Private: only you can see this. Farms only see your visa type and whether it covers their job dates. We never ask for your passport number.
profileForm.postcodeHint: Used to show jobs near you.
profileForm.regions: Regions you’d like to work in
profileForm.groupHint: Each person creates their own profile and applies; farms will see you’re travelling together.

jobForm.title: Job title
jobForm.descriptionHint: Start times, what the work involves, what to bring.
jobForm.guaranteeHint: Required. Piece-rate workers must earn at least the {{type}} award minimum ({{rate}}/hr).
jobForm.workersSee: Workers will see: {{rate}} per {{unit}}, at least {{min}}/hr guaranteed.
jobForm.accommodationCost: Accommodation cost per week (0 if free)
jobForm.specifiedNote: Plant and animal cultivation in an eligible regional postcode usually counts towards a 2nd or 3rd working holiday visa. Ticked automatically from the postcode.
jobForm.notEligible: This postcode isn’t on the eligible list for plant and animal cultivation. Workers on 417/462 visas will see that. Only leave this on if it’s another kind of specified work.
jobForm.eligible: This postcode is eligible for plant and animal cultivation, so workers will see that whatever you choose.
jobForm.stillPost: You can still post this job, but please check the pay first.

errors.abnTaken: That ABN is already registered on Croppr. Contact support if this is your business.

constraints.shift_logs_hours_check: A shift can be at most 24 hours.
constraints.payslips_period_length_check: A pay period can be at most 31 days. Add longer periods as separate payslips.
constraints.payslips_hours_check: That’s more than 24 hours per day worked. Check the total hours and days worked.
constraints.payslips_days_worked_min_check: Enter how many days you worked.
constraints.payslips_check: The pay period ends before it starts.
constraints.payslips_check1: Days worked can’t be more than the days in the pay period.

errors.offline: Can’t reach the Croppr server. Check your internet connection and try again.
